workflow: synthetic fault report or sensor ping
worker snapshot/restart without a second dispatch
acceptance: fault identity is the idempotency key
duplicate sensor ping and duplicate report share one store row
complete faults dispatch once to the class tech lane
incomplete or hold faults route once to HELD_INCOMPLETE with zero dispatches
worker restart after a mid-handoff crash resumes to one dispatch
rollback of a crashed run returns a clean un-dispatched state
a finished dispatch is not rollbackable and stays single-dispatched
same id with different bytes returns FAULT_CONFLICT and keeps the original dispatch
PII-shaped keys and live phone/email values are refused
live plant control, CMMS writes, purchasing, and safety decisions remain zero

commercial.refund: If the accepted diagnostic is not delivered inside the one-business-day window, the paid diagnostic amount is refunded unless the buyer elects in writing to receive one free next-business-day repair instead.

data_boundary: browser-local synthetic fixtures only; no live plant; no PII; no server submission
decision_boundary: handoff routing only; never live dispatch, CMMS write, purchasing, or a safety decision
